overview.summary: The canary_gitlab extension provides GitLab API helpers and a merge-request reporter for posting Canary results to GitLab merge requests.

capabilities: Post a success note to a GitLab merge request.
Post a failed test summary to a GitLab merge request.
Include a CDash build URL when provided.

security_notes: GitLab API actions require an access token.
Artifact zip extraction blocks absolute paths and parent traversal.
